mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 490000) indicates robust consumer spending, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 490000, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and preemptive monetary tightening by the Fed.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances during high labor market tightness periods, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1250 (thousands of units) indicates robust residential construction, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1250, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising year-over-year CPIAUCSL (inflation) erodes real corporate earnings and increases the real cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY is positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
